body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Audiovox showcased its water-proof RCA compact camcorder 'Small Wonder(model: EZ4000)' at CES 2010, which is designed for the person who likes their activities wet or dry.

The slim design fits perfectly in a shirt pocket or fanny pack. It offers HD video recording in (1080p) H.264 as well as a sports recording mode (WVGA@60fps). The micro SD card expansion slot can expand up to 16GB and the two-inch screen size allows for clear video and still-photo playback. There's also a built-in rechargeable battery and Memory Manager software. Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP): 169.99. This unit will be available in the spring of 2010.
